provenance.extractionMethod: Parsed embedded JavaScript data arrays from the HTML response supplied by the user.
provenance.zoneMappingSource: Official Nagpur City Police document listing stations under Zones 3, 4 and 5: https://nagpurpolice.gov.in/uploads/1761307514-DocScanner24Oct20255-22pm_compressed.pdf
provenance.mappingLimitation: Zone 3–5 assignments are taken from the official document. Unmatched stations are marked unverified; Zone 1 and Zone 2 mapping requires confirmation from the current official roster.
provenance.importantLimitation: The embedded police-station records do not include a zone field. Police stations are listed individually, but are not assigned to zones to avoid guessing.

notes.Extraction method: Parsed embedded JavaScript data arrays from the HTML response supplied by the user.
notes.Zone-wise data: Zone-level reported crime counts and detection percentages for 2023 and 2024.
notes.Police-station-wise data: 35 station names with reported crime counts and detection percentages for 2023 and 2024.
notes.Important limitation: The embedded police-station records do not include a zone field. Police stations are listed individually, but are not assigned to zones to avoid guessing.
notes.Data scope: The workbook reflects data embedded in the uploaded HTML snapshot. It may not represent the dashboard's current live state.
notes.Totals: Summary totals are calculated sums of the extracted arrays. Dashboard sections may use different scopes, so totals are shown separately.
